2607.21424.title: An Evaluation Framework for Structured Audio Captions Validated by Controlled Perturbations
2607.21424.paper_summary: Recent advancements in automated audio captioning (AAC) have shifted from monolithic sentence generation toward structured formats that explicitly disentangle distinct acoustic and semantic properties. However, evaluating this heterogeneous data remains a significant challenge. Existing caption metrics focus on flat textual outputs and fail to reliably assess multimodal attributes. To bridge this gap, we propose a multi-axis evaluation framework tailored for structured audio descriptions. Building on the AudioCards dataset, we evaluate outputs across five orthogonal axes: tag-sets, descriptions, logical reasoning, numeric measurements, and spectral profiles. Our approach combines Large Language Model (LLM) judges to capture semantic nuance with deterministic computational metrics to precisely measure acoustic deviations. To rigorously validate the reliability of this framework, we introduce a controlled perturbation testing protocol that injects typed, graded errors into groundtruth annotations. Our results demonstrate that this framework successfully distinguishes meaning-preserving paraphrases from genuine semantic and acoustic corruptions.
2607.21424.paper_summary_zh: 最近在自動音頻字幕生成（AAC）方面的進展，已經從單一的句子生成轉向結構化格式，明確區分不同的聲學和語義特性。<lb/>然而，評估這種異質數據仍然是一個重大挑戰。<lb/>現有的字幕指標專注於平面文本輸出，無法可靠地評估多模態屬性。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們提出了一個多軸評估框架，專為結構化音頻描述量身定制。<lb/>基於AudioCards數據集，我們在五個正交軸上評估輸出：標籤集、描述、邏輯推理、數值測量和頻譜特徵。<lb/>我們的方法結合了大型語言模型（LLM）評審，以捕捉語義細微差別，並使用確定性計算指標來精確測量聲學偏差。<lb/>為了嚴格驗證這一框架的可靠性，我們引入了一種控制擾動測試協議，將類型化、分級的錯誤注入到真實標註中。<lb/>我們的結果表明，這一框架成功地區分了保持意義的同義改寫與真正的語義和聲學損壞。
